projects.title: AntiGravity Agentic Studio
projects.summary: Next-generation collaborative IDE and agentic workspace for autonomous software engineering workflows.
projects.description: Engineered a high-performance agent orchestration environment featuring real-time terminal streaming, dynamic tool sandboxing, and context-aware diff generation. Reduced developer debugging cycles by 45%.

projects.title: CloudMesh Distributed Telemetry
projects.summary: Real-time distributed tracing and observability pipeline for high-throughput microservices.
projects.description: Architected an event-driven telemetry ingestion engine processing over 50,000 trace events/sec with sub-millisecond p99 latency using Golang, Kafka, and Redis cluster caching.

projects.title: Nebula Design System & UI Kit
projects.summary: Accessible, token-driven component system with glassmorphism micro-interactions and dark-mode defaults.
projects.description: Built a comprehensive component library with strict WCAG AAA compliance, zero runtime CSS overhead via modern CSS tokens, and 60fps hardware-accelerated animations.

projects.title: VectorFlow CLI & Migrator
projects.summary: High-speed developer CLI for zero-downtime vector database indexing and migration schemas.
projects.description: Developed an open-source command line tool written in Rust that parallelizes embedding chunking and schema migrations across Pinecone, Qdrant, and Milvus.

projects.title: WebAudio Synthwave Studio
projects.summary: In-browser modular synthesizer and visualizer using the Web Audio API and Canvas rendering.
projects.description: Built an interactive audio workstation in the browser with polyphonic oscillators, custom reverb impulse filters, and 60fps audio-reactive spectral visuals.

projects.title: Zero-Trust Identity Vault
projects.summary: Decentralized identity verification service with biometric WebAuthn and passkey support.
projects.description: Implemented cryptographic passkey registration, JWT rotation with asymmetric key pairs, and role-based access control policies for enterprise SaaS clients.
